reason: The first clarified Codex process exceeded the configured 1800-second timeout, but subprocess.run on Windows terminated only the npx parent and then waited on inherited child pipes. The outer harness was stopped after 3700 seconds and the orphaned Codex process tree was terminated manually.
available_evidence: The isolated workspace contained only the approved packet and rendered pages; no implementation, response, or event stream had been written.
disposition: Timeout attempt retained as workflow evidence; process-tree timeout handling is corrected before retrying the same pre-evaluation run ID.
